content:
Beyond Models. Building Production AI Systems. Artificial Intelligence is no longer just about building accurate models. Success comes from designing reliable systems that can integrate data, software, cloud infrastructure, and business workflows into solutions that people trust and use every day.
That belief has shaped my career and continues to influence every project I build.
My Journey #I am an AI Engineer and Data Scientist with experience designing machine learning and Generative AI solutions across logistics, manufacturing, and enterprise analytics.
My professional journey has taken me through global organizations including Tata Consultancy Services, Amazon, and Altimetrik, where I have worked on problems involving predictive analytics, optimization, Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, and enterprise AI platforms.
Along the way, I completed my Master’s in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning at the University of Birmingham, United Kingdom, strengthening my foundation in modern AI while gaining an international perspective on engineering and innovation.
Today, my focus is building production-ready AI systems that combine software engineering best practices with modern AI technologies.
My Engineering Philosophy #I believe successful AI products are built on four equally important pillars.
Build for Production #A model is only valuable when it can be deployed, monitored, maintained, and continuously improved.
Solve Business Problems #Technology should always support measurable business outcomes rather than exist as a demonstration of technical capability.
Engineer for Scale #Architecture, maintainability, testing, and observability are as important as model performance.
Keep Learning #Artificial Intelligence evolves rapidly. Continuous learning and experimentation are essential for building modern AI systems.
Areas of Interest #My primary interests include:
Agentic AI Large Language Models (LLMs) Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Machine Learning Natural Language Processing AI Platform Engineering AI Evaluation Cloud MLOps Backend Engineering Enterprise Software Architecture What I’m Building #My long-term goal is to build a collection of open-source projects that demonstrate production-quality AI engineering.
Current focus areas include:
Enterprise RAG SQL Agent AI Template Python LLM Evaluation Platform Agentic Cost Optimizer Travel Recommendation AI Customer Feedback NLP Each project is designed to showcase engineering practices such as clean architecture, testing, containerization, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and maintainable software design.
Continuous Learning #Artificial Intelligence changes quickly, and I enjoy staying current with new research, engineering practices, and production technologies.
My learning focuses on:
AI System Design Agentic Workflows Modern Software Architecture Cloud-Native AI MLOps Distributed Systems Open Source AI Frameworks Looking Ahead #My aspiration is to contribute to organizations building the next generation of intelligent software.
I enjoy working on challenging engineering problems where Artificial Intelligence, software engineering, and scalable system design come together to create meaningful business impact.
As this portfolio grows, it will continue to document not only the projects I build, but also the engineering decisions, architectural trade-offs, and lessons learned throughout the journey.
I’m always interested in connecting with engineers, researchers, recruiters, and organizations building innovative AI products. If you’d like to discuss Artificial Intelligence, software engineering, or potential opportunities, I’d be happy to connect.
